onboarding.title: Get started
onboarding.description: Ship a change behind a flag, measure it, and let an experiment tell you whether to keep it.

flag.title: Create a flag
flag.description: A flag wraps the code you want to change. Start with an on/off flag around one new behavior.

sdk.title: Connect the SDK
sdk.description: Add this code to your app ({{name}}'s SDK key is filled in). The SDK downloads flags once and evaluates them locally, so checking a flag never makes a request.

metric.description: Call {{call}} where the outcome happens, then turn that event into a metric like "share of users who purchased".

experiment.title: Start an experiment
experiment.description: Pick the flag, a primary metric and the traffic split. furca assigns users deterministically and tells you when the result is real.
